name: Bank statement email → Reconciler → Google Sheets (+ alert if not VERIFIED)

parameters.content:
## Bank statement check
MT940 / camt.053 / BAI2 / CODA attachment arrives by email → Bank Statement Reconciler (RapidAPI) checks opening + transactions = closing → one row per statement in Google Sheets → email alert when a statement is not VERIFIED.

**Set up**
1. IMAP credential for the mailbox the bank sends to.
2. Header Auth credential: name `X-RapidAPI-Key`, value = your key from rapidapi.com/SSYkolos/api/bank-statement-reconciler1 (free plan works).
3. Google Sheets: paste your sheet URL; first row = column names (the node can create them).
4. SMTP credential + your address in the alert node.

Nothing is stored by the API; the file is processed in memory.
